title: CMA Executive
description:
Area 
 Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities Product Costing 
 Prepare and maintain standard cost estimates in SAP S/4 HANA.
 • Prepare product cost sheets and conversion cost calculations.
 • Support costing for new product introductions and technology transfers.
 • Analyze cost variances and product profitability. US Product Costing & COGS 
 Prepare COGS for US market products.
 • Develop cost sheets for Baddi, Topical and Viona products.
 • Support budget cycle costing for regulated market products.
 • Monitor product profitability and margins. Plant Accounting 
 Manage plant costing and accounting activities.
 • Review daily production reports and utility consumption.
 • Monitor manufacturing cost trends and cost variances.
 • Support monthly financial closing activities. MIS & Financial Reporting 
 Prepare monthly MIS and Finance Dashboard.
 • Analyze P&L performance, yield variances and manpower productivity.
 • Present key financial highlights and improvement opportunities.
 • Support management reviews through financial analytics. Budgeting & Forecasting 
 Prepare annual OPEX budgets and monthly forecasts.
 • Conduct budget versus actual analysis.
 • Support site cost control initiatives.
 • Monitor spending against approved budgets. Inventory & Asset Management 
 Support inventory valuation and inventory controls.
 • Conduct monthly physical verification of SFG and open production orders.
 • Support fixed asset verification and cleansing activities.
 • Monitor working capital related inventory performance. Cost Audit & Compliance 
 Coordinate cost audit activities and documentation.
 • Prepare cost audit data and statutory costing reports.
 • Maintain costing records and audit compliance.
 • Support internal and external audit requirements. SAP Costing & Absorption 
 Execute monthly SAP absorption runs.
 • Release standard costs in SAP S/4 HANA.
 • Monitor cost center allocations and absorption accuracy.
 • Ensure integrity of costing master data. Cost Improvement Initiatives 
 Validate SLIM and productivity projects.
 • Support savings tracking and realization.
 • Generate cost optimization opportunities.
 • Support operational excellence initiatives from a finance perspective. CAPEX Evaluation 
 Conduct financial evaluation of CAPEX proposals.
 • Track post-implementation benefits and ROI.
 • Support capital investment decision-making.

Key Skills: Product costing,Budgeting,CMA,Forecasting,Costing,Standard costing,MIS,Analytics
